item.title: Linux kernel RCE CVE-2026-98432
item.description: CVSSv3 Score: 9.8 CVE-2026-98432:ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it. Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req(). tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice. item.title: Google shuts down global botnet running on certified Android devices
item.description: Videostrong sold TV set-top boxes and other devices with pre-installed malware. The yearslong operation evaded Google’s security tests and established a botnet for cybercriminals. The post Google shuts down global botnet running on certified Android devices appeared first on CyberScoop .
